title: Interpretive Cultures: Resonance, randomness, and negotiated meaning for AI-assisted tarot divination
reasoning: The paper explores the use of AI in spiritual and divinatory practices (tarot). It utilizes Hartmut Rosa's Theory of Resonance to analyze how AI-assisted divination relates to 'internal' (self), 'horizontal' (social), and 'vertical' (cosmological/spiritual) axes of meaning-making, specifically discussing religion and techno-spirituality.
